name: DecideMatchProposal
description: Marks an approved receipt as issued in Priority: a person issued it in Priority by the copied instruction and types Priority's receipt number. decision priorityDone {receiptId | proposalIds, priorityReceiptNumber?}: Receipts.receiptStatus → הונפקה ב-Priority (issuedBy / issuedAt / priorityReceiptNumber), its ReceiptAllocations → הונפקה ב-Priority, the customer proposal (MatchProposals) → בוצעה ב-Priority and BankLines.status → קבלה הונפקה when the receipt came from a bank line; writes a ReceiptCheckSteps step (stage החלטה, actor משתמש). Refused (ok:false, Hebrew reason) when the receipt is still a draft or already issued. Writes fields first, status last, read-back; a failure rolls back. dryRun writes nothing. Nothing is written to Priority. (The old decisions approve / correct / reject / skip / resolveCustomer / approveReceipt / aliases were removed on 08.11: the customer and the receipt are approved by IssueReceipt, the allocation by ApplyAllocation.)

decision.description: priorityDone = the receipt was issued in Priority

proposalIds.description: MatchProposals row ids, when the caller has the proposal rather than the receipt

decidedBy.description: Display name of the person deciding

asOfDate.description: Clock for the demo: YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today in Asia/Jerusalem

dryRun.description: When true, only report what would be written; nothing changes

decidedByEmail.description: Email of the person deciding (AgentFeedback.byEmail on a correction)

priorityReceiptNumber.description: priorityDone: the receipt number Priority gave

receiptId.description: Receipts row id (preferred; agent cheques have no proposal)

results.description: Per receipt: previous / new receiptStatus, bank line and proposal updates

writeVerified.description: True only when every written row was read back and matches

receipt.description: {receiptKey, receiptId, bankLineId, customerCode, customerName, amount, receiptStatus, matchStatus, priorityReceiptNumber, issuedBy, issuedAt}; null when refused

usageDescription:
This action is triggered by:

- **Marking a receipt issued in Priority**: In step 2 "קבלה" of the receipt record on the "תקבולים" screen (or from a receipts task), for a bank receipt or an agent cheque, after the bookkeeper copied the instruction and issued the receipt in Priority, typing Priority's receipt number and clicking "הונפקה ב-Priority"
  Marks the receipt "הונפקה ב-Priority" with that number, together with its allocation lines and, for a bank receipt, its bank line. Shown for every approved receipt — bank receipt or agent cheque — that was not issued yet; hidden for drafts and for receipts already issued. Nothing is written to Priority.
